CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of Mount Carmel Contest? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Mount Carmel Contest.
   B. Apply the teaching of Mount Carmel Contest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Mount Carmel Contest to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Mount Carmel Contest has no place in daily life.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Noah and his sons? (1 mark)
   A. Say Noah and his sons has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Noah and his sons to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Noah and his sons with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Noah and his sons.

6. Which response best shows understanding of My purpose Talents and abilities? (1 mark)
   A. Say My purpose Talents and abilities has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of My purpose Talents and abilities with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use My purpose Talents and abilities to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My purpose Talents and abilities.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Family Unity? (1 mark)
   A. Use Family Unity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Family Unity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Family Unity.
   D. Say Family Unity has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Work? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Work with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work.
   C. Say Work has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Work to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

10. Which response best shows understanding of King Solomon the wise ruler? (1 mark)
   A. Say King Solomon the wise ruler has no place in daily life.
   B. Use King Solomon the wise ruler to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of King Solomon the wise ruler with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing King Solomon the wise ruler.

11. Which response best shows understanding of The call of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Use The call of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The call of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The call of Moses has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The call of Moses.

12. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Birth of Moses has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Birth of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth of Moses.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Birth of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Healing the Paralysed Man and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Parable of the Lost Sheep and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Rich Young Ruler 3 3.9 A Friend at Midnight 3 Page 12 of 87 xii 4.0 The Chur and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Rich Young Man and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
